narr: A moist, southwesterly fetch aloft paralleled a stationary front draped across northeast Tennessee to produce areas of heavy rainfall and flooding, along with severe thunderstorms and tornadoes.
ev: Flooding of streams and yards reported.
Flooding at Jefferson's Restaurant on Battle Creek Road in Kimball. Restaurant was reopened within two hours after the event.
Almost a foot of water covered a road.
Flooding of Whites School Road, River Divide Road, and Goose Gap Road, all in the vicinity of Whites Adult High School.
Wilkinson Pike closed by flooding near Cutshaw Road, perhaps from flooding of Crooked Creek.
Jeffries Hollow Road was flooded and closed near the Blount and Sevier County line.
